resolutions.researcher_notes: DEAD_LINK current_ref was a /save/ trigger URL for dnr.gxzf.gov.cn t17807336, not a real snapshot address; the actual Wayback capture of that same underlying page (2024-09-25 snapshot) is a 2023-12-07 Guangxi Dept. of Natural Resources land-use pre-review ledger entry naming this exact segment '广西天然气支线管网项目来宾天然气支线管道工程（武宣-象州-金秀段）' — evidence the project is still at the pre-construction land-pre-review stage, consistent with 'proposed'. Corroborated independently by a second, separately-issued official document: the 2022-08-23 re-approval (project code 2019-451300-57-02-005045, same as the original 2020 approval) — a re-approval is only issued when the original approval's stated 2-year validity lapsed without construction starting (doc text: 核准文件有效期2年...未开工建设也未申请延期的...本核准文件自动失效), i.e. still unbuilt as of Aug 2022. Together, two independent government sources spanning 2022-2023 show no construction has commenced through the most recent evidence, supporting 'proposed'. No fresher (2024-2026) construction-start evidence found in Chinese-language search (开工/施工/招标 + segment name).
